entities.text: JOGEGOWDA & OTHERS VS. STATE OF KARNATAKA & OTHERS
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner is more than justified in contending that in the cognate case mentioned above, the acquisition proceedings have been quashed and that since issuance of Preliminary Notification nothing has been done in the matter despite lapse of prescribed period and therefore the same relief should be granted to his client.

Contra submission made by learned Panel Counsel appearing for 2nd respondent-MUDA is not convincing inasmuch as, a Division Bench of this Court in W.A.Nos.932-933/1974 between A.V.VINODA & ANOTHER Vs. STATE OF KARNATAKA BY ITS COMMISSIONER & SECRETARY, disposed off on 11.12.1974, has held that the Court should treat the like-cases alike and if relief is granted to a litigant it has to be extended to a similarly situated litigant as well, there being no derogatory circumstances.

entities.text: A.V.VINODA & ANOTHER Vs. STATE OF KARNATAKA
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above, this writ petition is disposed off quashing the Preliminary Notification dated 28.06.2016 to the extent the same comprises the petition land.
